description: Navigates to the public campus transit web portal, searches for a designated shuttle stop, and extracts the next upcoming departure times and active delay alerts.

inputs.name: stop_name
inputs.description: Name or identifier of the campus shuttle stop to monitor

steps.description: Open the real-time shuttle tracking portal on the bot's cloud browser
Enter the dynamic stop name into the search field
Extract the next 3 departures and any active service advisories
Format and deliver the transit briefing into the chat thread
